instruction.text: Read the text and solve the problem.

atoms.a: The dinner cost £165 for a group of friends, and they left a tip of £26.40. How much did they tip, as a percentage?
If Martin leaves £9.35 as a tip, and he tips 17%, what was the cost of the bill?
Landon has read 75 pages of his book today. If he has read 12% of his book, how long is the book?
Maritza has read 285 pages of her book. If the book is 750 pages long, what percentage of the book has she read?

instruction.text: Read the text and solve the problems.

atoms.a: The Hilltop Diner has served 36 orders of omelettes, 27 orders of waffles and 27 orders of pancakes this morning. How many orders were for omelettes and waffles combined?
atoms.b: There were <mat><gap>63</gap></mat> orders for omelettes and waffles.

atoms.a: What percent of all orders were omelettes and waffles together?
atoms.b: <mat><gap>70</gap></mat> % of all orders were omelettes or waffles.

instruction.text: Read the text and solve the problems.

atoms.a: Café La Palma is open for breakfast and lunch. The breakfast burrito is available only for breakfast, and 60% of the 160 breakfast customers order it. How many customers ordered the breakfast burrito?
If there are 384 customers in the whole day, what percentage of them had a breakfast burrito?
atoms.b: <mat><gap>25</gap></mat> % of all customers ordered the breakfast burrito that day.

instruction.text: Read the text and solve the problems.

atoms.a: Emma is driving across the country on a road trip. The total distance she will drive is <mat>3390</mat> miles. After two days, she has driven <mat>813.6</mat> miles. What percentage of the trip has she completed?
atoms.b: Emma has completed <mat><gap>24</gap></mat> % of the trip.

atoms.a: At this rate, how many days will Emma need to complete her trip? Give your answer as an integer.
atoms.b: Emma will need <mat><gap>9</gap></mat>days to complete her trip.

atoms.a: On the last day, what percentage of the journey will she have left?
atoms.b: She will have <mat><gap>4</gap></mat> % of her journey left on her last day.
